rules: Server state determines progress, ranking, winners, and deadlines.
Animate only the visible lane window; key by stable player ID.
Use FLIP for lane reordering; avoid layout reads in the typing handler.
Keep progress interpolation separate from chassis animation.
Do not delay interaction while screen transitions play.
Cancel transient timers when a racer finishes or a component unmounts.
Reduced motion: disable transforms, spinning, shake, confetti and smooth scrolling; show final state immediately.
Queue at most one noncritical race banner; replace stale overtake announcements.
